mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, m.spec, m.safety_stock, m.shelf_life_days, m.note, m.image_url, m.status, m.version, coalesce(b.quantity, 0) AS current_stock FROM material m JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL

sql.if: AND coalesce(b.quantity, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.material_id = m.id AND sm.type = 'OUT' AND sm.reversed = false AND sm.occurred_at > now() - interval '90 days' )

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM material m JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id LEFT JOIN stock_balance b ON b.material_id = m.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM stock_movement WHERE material_id = #{id}
